title: fix(cli): reject music options when --timestamps is requested
author: Saauf

gist.summary: `polli gen audio --timestamps` now rejects `--duration` and `--instrumental` before making a network request. The timestamped speech endpoint supports speech fields only, so those music options were previously accepted but silently dropped. The CLI now explains that timestamps are available for speech models only; regression tests cover both combinations.
